## Introduction 

The Concept of Homicide as One of the Gravest Crimes 

Homicide, in its simplest sense, refers to the killing of one human being by another. Among all offences 

known to criminal law, homicide occupies the most serious position because it involves the destruction of 

human life —the very foundation of civil society. Unlike offences against property, liberty, or reputation,
